original_test_intent: Prove each mapped BlueField Ethernet port has correct up/down reachability, physical indication and stable recovery through five link-flap cycles.
original_method: Map serial/BDF/netdev/physical port/peer/IP; isolate the link and maintain alternate access; preserve baseline; operator executes approved down/up transitions while automation records full ethtool, counters, dmesg and bounded ping for every cycle; visually record LEDs; restore and verify unchanged configuration.
manual_activity: Operator controls five flaps per mapped Ethernet port and observes LEDs; network owner ensures isolation/recovery and owns verdict.
required_inputs: Per-state ping target, dwell, timeout and loss oracle
Alternate access, maintenance window and recovery plan
safety_requirements: Do not choose ports by vendor loop alone
Never flap the active management path without alternate access
Preserve full logs and per-cycle state
Stop on unexpected loss, error or failed restoration; no auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Correlate operator LED record and verify restoration
Do not trigger unapproved flaps or make verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ethtool/dmesg are useful corroboration but the broad vendor loop and static snapshot do not perform five flaps, ping checks or physical observation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use exact-interface full ethtool/counter/dmesg and bounded ping capture around each operator-controlled down/up transition.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Five cycles per port, up/down reachability, final normal state and 10-minute allocations are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Drive a port-specific five-cycle table combining operator action/LED observation with synchronized carrier, ping, counters and logs.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable identity, timing oracle, alternate path, stop/recovery and full evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Static ethtool or a visual LED alone cannot establish repeated recovery and reachability.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Flaps disrupt traffic and can disconnect management; ping depends on peer and routing.

project_override_considerations: Owner must define ports, OS versus fixture flap, dwell/timeouts, acceptable packet loss/recovery latency and required LED evidence.
expected_evidence: Five indexed down/up carrier and ping results per port
Final unchanged address/route and restored link/management

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source is an active five-cycle flap/ping test, while DeepSeek produces only a static link/speed/log report plus a visual note.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution blocks without exact port mapping, safe fixture/isolation, alternate access, operator/LED evidence or recovery oracle.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row393 Wistron-Networking-00382-V003: approve exact BlueField BDF/netdev/physical-port/peer/IP mapping, OS versus fixture flap mechanism, five-cycle dwell/ping/loss/recovery oracle, LED legend/operator evidence, isolation, alternate access and abort/restoration rules.

review_improvement: Creates an auditable five-cycle behavioral test instead of treating a one-time vendor-filtered status dump as equivalent coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Carrier, reachability, physical indication and post-flap stability are separate observables. Each must be captured for the same mapped port and cycle; vendor ID selection alone cannot distinguish PF/VF or physical port and a static link-up state proves no recovery behavior.
